verdict.rationale: Docs mention recall() can auto-classify queries and pick 'the best retrieval strategy' implying multiple underlying search modes exist, and a founder comment references 'nodesets' (tag-like) and per-user graph filtering, hinting at metadata-style filtering — but there is no explicit documentation of developer-facing keyword/hybrid search toggles, reranking controls, or metadata filter APIs. missing for 10: explicit API/docs for keyword or hybrid search modes, reranking configuration, and structured metadata filter parameters exposed to developers.
